declared_intent.mechanism: phased feint -> legal-response observation -> main-axis switch

trigger_and_switch: FEINT: small feint group advances on axis A; main+reserve hold east
OBSERVE_RESPONSE: legal get_black_targets() White near axis A (>=2 within 60km)
TIMEOUT_SWITCH: no response by 7000 sim-s -> bounded fallback push
SWITCH/MAIN_PUSH: commit main force to axis B (opposite lateral lane)
RESERVE_COMMIT: one-time when main centroid x<=180km
FEINT_ATTRITION/DEGRADED: early push / keep last orders
known_strengths: reserve usage and axis shift absent in B0-B3
known_weaknesses: feint wastes time if White does not over-commit
discrete switch may raise resolution time
delayed main commitment may lower early pressure
